name: 3rd Coast Cubing 2019
information: In Holland, we are surrounded by beautiful beaches on the coast of Lake Michigan. With the first WCA competition to take place in Holland, we hope that you will all set PBs by the beach. There will be TWO rounds of Redi cube in this competition for the MoYu Redi Cube Cup. This is not an official WCA event, so these rounds do not appear in the Events tab, but they are listed on the schedule. The only requirement is that you know how to solve, and have a redi cube.
